proposals.evidence: DEDR1654 gives Tamil kuṭi (-pp-, -tt-), Malayalam kuṭikka, Kannada kuḍi/kuḍu and Kodagu kuḍi- (kuḍip-, kuḍic-) drink. These simple and ordinary participial/nominal survey forms retain that drink stem and documented inflectional bases; source vowel/voicing and final morphology are preserved. Possible causative kuḍisu forms and opaque auxiliaries are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
